name: Normal Equations-based Solver
definition: A method to solve the box-constrained least squares problem $\forall i \in [1,...,n] : 0 \le x_i \le 1$ by formulating it as a quadratic programming problem.
summary: The Normal Equations-based Solver solves box-constrained least squares via quadratic programming, distinguishing itself by handling constraints unlike its unconstrained parent, though it risks instability with ill-conditioned matrices.
